necessity_paragraph: The claim for CPT 93229 was denied under code CO-50 for lack of medical necessity. The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes associated with diagnosis R42.
